notes: Direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/blocking). Shopify storefront (clay-craft-india.myshopify.com). Site is a ceramic tableware/drinkware manufacturer; confirmed via mega-menu HTML (BY CATEGORY = Tableware + Tea & Coffee Serving + Hotelware; separate VACBOTT menu = Stainless Steel Drinkware) that this is the complete navigable product taxonomy. Full catalog enumerated via /collections/all/products.json (6 pages, 1301 unique products) and grouped by product_type: every type is a tableware/drinkware type (mugs, dinner sets, bowls, cups, kettles, water bottles, etc.) - zero lighting, zero mirror, zero clock, zero furniture/textile product types found. Site search for lamp/light/mirror/clock/vase/candle-holder/wall-art/planter/figurine/sculpture returned only fuzzy false-positive matches (e.g. 'lamp' matched mug/cup-saucer titles with no actual lamp products; 'mirror' matched a tea cup name; 'clock' matched a water bottle) - confirmed by opening each result list and reading titles, not just trusting the result count (per false-absence-test lesson). All Tableware/Tea & Coffee Serving/Stainless Steel Drinkware categories are filed under Kitchen & Dining per project scope (tableware/dinnerware in scope). Excluded per NEVER-EXTRACT rule: 'BY COLLECTIONS' mega-menu group (Basics, Disney, Ebony, Happiness Is, Hilton, Impression, India Circus, JCPL, Magique by The Wishing Chair, Pebble) - these are brand/pattern/franchise roll-up collections that duplicate products already counted in the Tableware/Tea&Coffee categories (mixed roll-ups, not genuine product types). Also excluded: *SALE*, UNDER 199, NEW ARRIVALS (filter/promo pages), HOTELWARE (a B2B contact/catalogue-download page, not a browsable product listing - no products.json listing exists for it), ABOUT/INVESTORS (corporate pages). QTY VERIFICATION: Shopify products_count (collections.json) proved inflated vs actual enumerated unique product count on this site too (e.g. Tabletop Accessories: products_count=52 vs 28 actual; Platters: 36 vs 23; Plates: 40 vs 35; Coffee Mug Sets: 155 vs 150) - every qty below is the ENUMERATED unique-handle count from /collections/<handle>/products.json (single page, all under 250 items so no pagination risk), never the raw products_count field. Two isolated decorative items found only via site search / an orphan un-navigable collection (a single 'Candle Stand' product and a 'Budvase' ceramic vase, both only reachable via the excluded Basics brand collection or direct product search, with no dedicated nav category or collection page of their own) were left out as immaterial single-SKU search artifacts rather than fabricating a category the site itself does not maintain; two ceramic statues (Ganesha, Buddha Head) found the same way ARE already counted inside Tabletop Accessories since they appear in that collection's product listing. No duplicate-company signal found (unique brand, unique domain, standard Shopify India tableware manufacturer storefront).
